dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington neighborhood boundaries defined by busstime group. Data covers the western area of King County.

Purpose: The neighborhood coverage was generated for the ATIS application used by the Regional Automated Trip Planning group (RATP). This group assists Metro bus riders to get from one location to another taking the best route possible. Helps users specify a general area in a trip planning query without knowing a specific landmark or address.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
